boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission, no-purchase activities at St. Lawrence and in Canton.

cards.title: Browse the Brush Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Griffiths Arts Center · St. Lawrence University
cards.notes: Visit the rotating exhibitions during the academic year; check the gallery page before heading over for the current display and visitor hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery with changing visual-art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence describes the Richard F. Brush Art Gallery as free and open to the public during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Richard F. Brush Art Gallery to Present Exhibition
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated for the academic year; verify current gallery hours before visiting.

cards.title: Catch a free weekend movie
cards.subtitle: Sullivan Student Center · St. Lawrence University
cards.notes: Look for the weekend film offering in the Student Center and bring a friend; the university specifically lists these movies as free.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost campus movie option held on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence lists attending free movies in the Student Center each weekend among student activities.
cards.access_notes: Program is presented as a student activity; consult the campus calendar for a specific screening.

cards.title: Walk the campus trail network
cards.subtitle: Nine campus trails · St. Lawrence University
cards.notes: Choose a daylight walk through the university’s campus trails; use the map or Outdoor Program resources to plan a route that fits your time.
cards.short_summary: Nine public campus trails through St. Lawrence grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence states that its nine campus trails are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The university notes that walking trails close at dusk; stay on designated routes.

cards.title: Take the Saddlemire Trail loop
cards.subtitle: Starts behind Hulett and Jencks · St. Lawrence University
cards.notes: Start behind Hulett and Jencks for an easy 2.1-mile route with boardwalks, Tracy Brook, Little River, and views near the golf course.
cards.short_summary: An easy campus trail with boardwalk sections and water features.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence's Outdoor Program identifies Saddlemire Trail as a 2.1-mile easy trail beginning behind Hulett and Jencks dormitories.
cards.access_notes: No admission or purchase is required because it is part of the university's free public campus trail network; trails close at dusk.

cards.title: Walk Kip Trail from the field station
cards.subtitle: Wachtmeister Field Station · St. Lawrence University
cards.notes: Begin at Wachtmeister Field Station and follow this easy 2.2-mile campus route; bring water and return before the university’s dusk trail closure.
cards.short_summary: An easy 2.2-mile campus walk from Wachtmeister Field Station.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence's Outdoor Program lists Kip Trail as an easy 2.2-mile route starting at Wachtmeister Field Station.
cards.access_notes: No admission or purchase is required because it is part of the university's free public campus trail network; trails close at dusk.

cards.title: Navigate the St. Lawrence Orienteering Course
cards.subtitle: Wachtmeister Field Station near Kip Trail · St. Lawrence University
cards.notes: Download the free map and instructions, then work through the controls with a friend; stay oriented and follow the site’s safety and Leave No Trace guidance.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided navigation course with free maps.
cards.evidence_claim: Nature Up North states that the St. Lawrence Orienteering Course is open to the public and provides free downloadable maps and instructions.
cards.access_notes: Use daylight, follow the posted navigation advice, and do not cross the Little River.

cards.title: Attend a Writers Series reading
cards.subtitle: Sykes Common Room · 85 Park Street, Canton
cards.notes: Check the Writers Series schedule, then arrive for an author reading and Q&A; the university says these events are free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: Author readings and questions in Sykes Common Room.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence states that Writers Series author readings are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Readings are typically Thursday evenings; confirm the specific event schedule before going.

cards.entity_name: Alison Hawthorne Deming Writers Series Event
cards.title: Hear Alison Hawthorne Deming read
cards.subtitle: Sykes Common Room · October 20, 2026
cards.notes: Plan for the scheduled Writers Series event in Sykes Common Room, then stay for the reading’s conversation with the visiting author.
cards.short_summary: A free public Writers Series event with Alison Hawthorne Deming.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence lists the October 20, 2026 Alison Hawthorne Deming Writers Series event as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Writers Series and the Center for the Environment present Alison Hawthorne Deming
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for October 20, 2026, 8–9 p.m.; verify details on the event page before attending.

cards.entity_name: Shakespeare Theatre of New Jersey at St. Lawrence
cards.title: See free Shakespeare on campus
cards.subtitle: Eben Holden Center · March 12–14, 2027
cards.notes: Save the announced March dates for A Midsummer Night’s Dream or Romeo and Juliet; the university says no tickets are needed.
cards.short_summary: Two announced no-ticket Shakespeare performances at Eben Holden.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence states that its March 12–14, 2027 Shakespeare Theatre of New Jersey performances are free and open to the public with no tickets needed.
cards.access_notes: Performances are scheduled for March 12–14, 2027; confirm the chosen performance time before attending.

cards.entity_name: Performance and Communication Arts Public Events
cards.title: Watch a Performance and Communication Arts event
cards.subtitle: St. Lawrence University · Canton, NY
cards.notes: Use the university events calendar to find a faculty- or student-directed production, showcase, performance hour, lecture, or workshop that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: Public campus performances, lectures, showcases, and workshops.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Lawrence's catalog states that Performance and Communication Arts public events, including productions, showcases, lectures, and workshops, are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Individual events vary; use the current university calendar to confirm date, venue, and any entry requirements.
